claims.title: Provenance
claims.description: Complete provenance chain from conception to deployment with dated artifacts and design records

claims.title: HITL for high-risk operations
claims.description: Human-in-the-loop enforcement for all high-risk operations with approval workflow

claims.title: Tamper-evident audit
claims.description: Cryptographically chained audit log with hash verification and concurrency safety

claims.title: Privacy compliance
claims.description: GDPR/AI Act compliance with DPIA, DPA, and privacy-by-design implementation

claims.title: Financial atomicity
claims.description: All financial mutations execute atomically with double-entry ledger and balance protection

claims.title: Database authority consolidation
claims.description: Single authoritative PostgreSQL database (DATABASE_URL) with Supabase as Identity Provider only

claims.title: Sovereign state transactional persistence
claims.description: SovereignDB uses transactional PostgreSQL persistence with BEGIN/VALIDATE/LOCK/MUTATE/LEDGER/AUDIT/COMMIT pattern

claims.title: Kill switch durable with approval store
claims.description: Kill switch uses durable PostgreSQL approval store in production, not in-memory Map

claims.title: MFA step-up for SovereignOwner
claims.description: Privileged operations require MFA step-up authentication

claims.title: CSP hardened without unsafe-inline
claims.description: Content Security Policy enforced without 'unsafe-inline', using nonce-based script loading
